content:
riya: Quick pass for HelioSoft — sales context: POC completed, customer requires Private deployment in VPC, Okta SSO mandatory, handles PII (L2). Target production launch 2024-11-15. ARR $120k. Trial ended; finance flagged trial infra overage. Renewal risk: medium-high if SSO or onboarding slips. Primary contacts: Riya (AE), Sam (CSM) -> owns onboarding, Shawn (SE) -> infra/SSO, Tasha (Support TL) -> escalations. Please confirm owners and next steps.

sam: got it, I'll own the onboarding and kickoff. Can someone paste the Okta metadata and the minimal network egress requirements? Scheduling kickoff with customer this Friday 10am PT.

shawn: noted. I'll run infra compatibility checks and SSO validation next week. Need customer's ASN and any peering constraints. I'll create tickets for infra work.

riya: ASN 64512, public IP block 203.0.113.0/22. Okta metadata link: https://okta.example.com/metadata/helio.xml. Customer requested two short ops trainings (2 x 45m).

lina-support: +1 on trainings. We'll prepare a runbook and an oncall rotation. Suggest support alias helio-support@redwood.com.

tasha: I can create the alias. If SSO becomes a blocker, should we plan a temporary token-based fallback? That has security implications though.

sam: prefer avoiding token fallback unless absolutely necessary. Plan: kickoff, try to complete SSO in two business days after kickoff. Action owners: Sam - onboarding plan & kickoff; Shawn - infra & SSO validation; Tasha/Lina - support runbook & alias; Riya - customer comms & contracts.

shawn: creating JIRA epics: RED-3387 (Helio private deploy) and RED-3388 (Helio SSO). I'll link here once created.

riya: dropping the minimal SP metadata snippet for SEs to validate:
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://helio.example.com/saml">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="POST" Location="https://helio.example.com/sso/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

sam: good. Customer success metric to track: 50k generated tokens/month by month 3. If adoption lags, renewal risk moves to high. Also capture two feature asks: improved embedding quality for domain-specific docs, and a lightweight admin console for tenant ops.

lina-support: noted. I'll add monitoring alerts to the runbook for token spikes and 500s, and include escalation steps.

shawn: SE needs access to their staging environment to run tests. Riya, can you share staging invite?

riya: invite sent to staging workspace and added customer to Zendesk as helio_ops. Also shared initial contract notes with finance.

sam: next-steps summary I'll add to the CS playbook: 1) Kickoff Fri 10am PT (Sam) 2) SE to validate infra & SSO by Mon next week (Shawn) 3) Support runbook + alias by Tue (Tasha/Lina) 4) Ops training sessions scheduled (Sam/Riya) 5) Create JIRA epics and link tickets in thread (Shawn) 6) Weekly adoption metric check-ins (Sam). Please set due dates in the tickets. :thumbsup:

shawn: will update RED-3387 & RED-3388 tomorrow with checklists and due dates.

tasha: creating helio-support alias now, will post runbook link here when ready.

riya: copying legal for DPA: @maria-legal — need DPA signoff for PII handling.

maria-legal: acknowledged. I'll review the DPA and aim for a 3 business day turnaround. If there are special clauses, I'll flag them here.

sam: tagging product-feedback to capture feature asks from the customer.

product-feedback: thanks — we'll intake both asks (embedding quality, admin console) and respond with a triage timeline.

sam: closing loop for now. If anything blocks SSO or infra, escalate to #eng-oncall and ping Shawn/Tasha directly. Thanks all!
